negative_knowledge.corpus: fxmerge.com archived strategy-results (49 extracted records, Wayback)
negative_knowledge.finding: On published retail MT4/MT5 track records, a LOW reported drawdown paired with a HIGH gain is a grid/martingale DETECTOR, not evidence of risk control. The reported figure is BALANCE drawdown; a grid holds losing legs open, so balance-DD stays near zero precisely while equity risk is at its maximum. 4/49 rows report drawdown of exactly 0.00% alongside gains of 1,350-1,979%, which is arithmetically impossible for a closed-equity series.
negative_knowledge.supporting_structure: 41/49 automated; leverage 1:500 or higher on 38/49; brokers are offshore high-leverage venues (FBS, JustMarkets, Headway, Tradehall, FX Winning); EA names cluster on gold (GOLDLOVER, XG Gold, Gold Hunter). That is the martingale-on-XAUUSD population, not a sample of systematic edges.
negative_knowledge.why_it_is_worth_recording: It prunes search space at zero cost: this desk should NEVER rank a public track record by gain/drawdown ratio, and any leaderboard-derived hypothesis whose parent shows balance-DD < ~12% at gain > 500% is presumed grid until the trade list proves otherwise. Selection-bias defense (RESEARCH SS4) applies on top: this section was REMOVED from the live site, so even the survivors here are survivors of a dead venue.
negative_knowledge.reopen_on: trade-by-trade tables becoming extractable (the archive renders them as JS placeholders), which would let the grid hypothesis be tested rather than inferred.
